name: open-twin-xr
description: Open-source web-based 3D human-body viewer. Renders real anatomy from registered open atlases and can colour it by supplied per-system metrics. WebXR in the browser and on a headset.
author: Martin Etzrodt, OSF Staff and Open Twin XR contributors

scripts.convert:hra: node --stack-size=4000 scripts/strip-atlas.mjs public/models/hra.glb public/models/hra.stripped.glb --join-by anatomical_structure_of --drop-normals && gltf-transform optimize public/models/hra.stripped.glb public/models/hra.opt.glb --compress meshopt --join false --instance false --weld true --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.3 --simplify-error 0.01 && node scripts/bake-ao.mjs public/models/hra.opt.glb --out public/models/hra.ao.glb
scripts.convert:hra-m: node --stack-size=4000 scripts/strip-atlas.mjs public/models/hra-m.glb public/models/hra-m.stripped.glb --join-by anatomical_structure_of --drop-normals && gltf-transform optimize public/models/hra-m.stripped.glb public/models/hra-m.opt.glb --compress meshopt --join false --instance false --weld true --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.3 --simplify-error 0.01 && node scripts/bake-ao.mjs public/models/hra-m.opt.glb --out public/models/hra-m.ao.glb
scripts.convert:z-anatomy: gltf-transform optimize public/models/z-anatomy.glb public/models/z-anatomy.opt.glb --compress meshopt --join false --instance false --weld true --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.35 --simplify-error 0.0005 && node scripts/bake-ao.mjs public/models/z-anatomy.opt.glb --out public/models/z-anatomy.ao.glb
scripts.convert:bodyparts3d: gltf-transform optimize public/models/bodyparts3d.glb public/models/bodyparts3d.opt.glb --compress meshopt --join false --instance false --weld true --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.5 --simplify-error 0.005 && node scripts/bake-ao.mjs public/models/bodyparts3d.opt.glb --out public/models/bodyparts3d.ao.glb
scripts.check:winding: node scripts/check-winding.mjs public/models/bodyparts3d.ao.glb public/models/z-anatomy.ao.glb public/models/hra.ao.glb public/models/hra-m.ao.glb public/models/htb-ct-003.glb public/models/biv-heart.glb public/models/eye.glb public/models/openear-zeta.glb public/models/anny-adult-m.glb public/models/anny-adult-f.glb public/models/anny-child.glb public/models/anny-elder.glb public/models/anny-pregnant.glb
scripts.convert:z-anatomy-regions: gltf-transform optimize public/models/z-anatomy-regions.glb public/models/z-anatomy-regions.opt.glb --compress meshopt --join false --instance false --weld true --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.5 --simplify-error 0.001 && node scripts/bake-ao.mjs public/models/z-anatomy-regions.opt.glb --out public/models/z-anatomy-regions.ao.glb
scripts.convert:anny: for f in adult-m adult-f child elder pregnant; do gltf-transform optimize public/models/anny-$f.raw.glb public/models/anny-$f.opt.glb --compress meshopt --join false --instance false --weld true --simplify false && node scripts/bake-ao.mjs public/models/anny-$f.opt.glb --out public/models/anny-$f.glb && node scripts/set-copyright.mjs public/models/anny-$f.glb "ANNY — NAVER LABS Europe / NAVER Corporation. Apache-2.0 code over CC0-1.0 MakeHuman-derived shape assets. arXiv:2511.03589. Baked by open-twin-openXR scripts/anny/bake.py; no scan of any person." || exit 1; done
